_meta.status: PROVISIONAL map fixtures. Terrain is generated by sim/map_gen.gd (river_crossing_s) and sim/maps/<id>.gd; tests/test_maps.gd checks that this file matches the generators (w, h, spawns, spawn_sets, max_sides, hold_bridge).
_meta.spawn_sets: Side i of an n-side match starts at spawns[spawn_sets[str(n)][i]]. Spawns 2k/2k+1 are point-symmetric mirror pairs on the G3b maps.
_meta.decor: Generated maps carry map.decor = [{id, cell (top-left), size}] using ART4's poi_decor ids; impassable footprints are Terrain.RIDGE cells until a building-terrain code exists.

maps.name: River Crossing
maps.blurb: Small valley: one river, a central bridge, two fords. Fast expansion, contest the crossing.

maps.name: Industrial Heartland
maps.blurb: Medium river basin: factory compounds, a rail siding, a refinery by the centre ford, a ruined plant, towns and a road loop per bank.

maps.name: Valley Conquest
maps.blurb: Large valley: a central dam, river branches, foothills with a tunnel portal, airfields and industrial pockets. Room for 10,000 units.
